protocol.method: FLTrust-structure scorer -- single global model, no local reward/sparsification, memoryless ReLU(cos)/sum trust weights (fltrust.trust_scores); clients rescaled to a fixed gamma_target (normalize_pseudo_gradient) instead of clipped to ||Delta_0|| (fltrust.clip_to_reference). Reported score is cos_ema, an unclamped EMA of the pre-ReLU cosine; a/r are mechanism artifacts logged for comparison, not the headline.

anchor.construction: perm[validation_size : validation_size + anchor_size] of the test split via randperm(anchor_root_seed); disjoint from the Parzen validation set perm[:validation_size]
anchor.gradient_mode: one full-batch SGD step, Delta_0 = -lr * grad F_root(w)
anchor.epoch_mode: E-epoch pseudo-gradient at the client batch size (default)
anchor.used_for: cosine direction AND aggregation weight sign; magnitude never used

protocol.seed_derivation: master_seed = stable_seed(key, base_seed + trial); client loader seed = stable_seed(f'{key}#fltrust_structure#r{t}#c{i}', master_seed); server loader seed = stable_seed(f'{key}#fltrust_structure#r{t}#server', master_seed)
protocol.contamination_mask: override-derived for mislabel; label-entropy-derived for noniid
